title: Intervention and Recovery Data
summary: Work through Intervention and Recovery Data.

blocks.md: This lesson follows **Intervention and Recovery Data** in *Physical Data* (Vol IV).

blocks.source: Vol IV, Physical Data, § Intervention and Recovery Data
blocks.md: A scenario cell, such as the cage-door latch displaced by $+3\text{ mm}$, may hold zero demonstrations in the training archive. That zero count alone cannot tell an engineer whether the robot never drifted there, whether the … contact tripwire aborted every attempt that reached it, whether a safety supervisor took over beforehand, or whether an ingestion script threw the failed episodes away. Treating those four absences as interchangeable either trains the policy to imitate a safety abort or discards the exact boundary states needed for recovery.

blocks.prompt: Think first: In two or three sentences, explain why Intervention curation matters for the system this section describes.
blocks.md: Compare your answer with the book's claim: A zero-count cell can mean unvisited, intercepted, cut short by takeover, or censored, and takeover logs are failure-conditioned, so curation locates the divergence point in a pre-trigger buffer and admits only verified recovery.

questions.q: The section **Intervention and Recovery Data** develops one of the chapter's claims. Which one?
options: Nominally identical units differ in transmission, mounts, and motor constants, so a failed attempt and a failed recording must be told apart per unit.
Teleoperation loop latency is display plus human plus command plus mechanics time, dominated by operator reaction, and it leaves step-and-wait artifacts in the labels.

A zero-count cell can mean unvisited, intercepted, cut short by takeover, or censored, and takeover logs are failure-conditioned, so curation locates the divergence point in a pre-trigger buffer and admits only verified recovery.
Physical data is bought in cell time and component life, so less than a quarter of a scheduled hour survives as retained demonstration and failed attempts wear parts like successful ones.
